verdicts.detail: The 'Just Add' (padEnd with '-' at line 15881) and 'Align to consensus' (alignSequenceToConsensusProfile at line 15848) details match. However 'Add & Align - realign the full alignment with MAFFT using add-keep-length mode' does NOT match: the browser MAFFT path (mafft-wasm.js addAndAlign) explicitly does NOT use the --add/keep-length pipeline. It states 'the full MAFFT --add pipeline requires multiple binaries... we use a simpler approach: combine existing and new sequences, strip all gaps, and re-align' (lines 135-137), and _stripGaps both inputs then re-aligns (line 143). This strips gaps and re-aligns rather than preserving alignment length via add-keep-length mode.

note: Audited 2 claims (13, 14). Claim 13 (Realign Block) = MATCH: Ctrl+Shift+R->realignSelectedBlock, columnRuns filters runs to length>=2 (single isolated columns ignored), per-run extract+degap+independent MAFFT call, splice-back via state.seqs. Claim 14 (Add sequence modes) = MISMATCH: Just Add (padEnd '-') and Align-to-consensus (alignSequenceToConsensusProfile) match, but Add & Align does NOT use add-keep-length mode in the browser path — mafft-wasm.js addAndAlign explicitly avoids the --add pipeline, strips gaps and re-aligns (not --keeplength).
